description: bigville R77 (block 396000): OBSERVED-DEMAND PRODUCTION on the data-driven world. po_observe forms the maker's beliefs from OBSERVED signals (adaptive expectation, harvest discounted by his unsold glut); pd_decide is a COLLAPSE over the ACTION catalog -- among his own trade's actions, Argmax by expected demand of the output -- setting will_make + want_qty (a run sized by demand). Ports the produce float world's belief/decide/run/glut onto bigville_world + the general engine; the produce float world is retired.

rules.name: pd_decide
rules.comment: THE MAKER DECIDES WHAT TO MAKE (a collapse over the ACTION catalog): among the actions of his OWN trade, he picks the one whose output he believes will SELL BEST -- expected demand = base + weight * his belief about that output's demand driver (harvest/building/storage). He sets will_make and want_qty (a run sized by that demand). A smith who believes the harvest will be big makes SCYTHES; one who expects a building boom makes NAILS. Makers DIVERGE on their beliefs.

rules.name: po_observe
rules.comment: BELIEF FROM OBSERVATION (not hand-set): the maker updates his beliefs toward what he OBSERVED (town.observed_*) by adaptive expectation (belief += 0.6*(signal - belief)); the HARVEST signal is discounted by his own UNSOLD glut (unsold*0.05) -- a pile of unsold scythes cools him.
